name: Residential Purchase Offer
description: A buyer’s offer on a home, by one buyer or two (a co-buyer signs beside the buyer): the property, the price and earnest money, the contingencies the buyer checks, the closing date and the offer’s expiry. The buyers sign, then the seller.

then.p: **{{buyer}}** (the "Buyer") offers to buy the property at **{{property}}** (the "Property") from {{seller}} (the "Seller") on the terms below.

**{{buyer}}** and **{{co_buyer}}** (together, the "Buyer", each bound jointly and severally) offer to buy the property at **{{property}}** (the "Property") from {{seller}} (the "Seller") on the terms below.

body.p: Purchase price: US${{price}}. Earnest money deposit: US${{earnest}}, delivered to the escrow holder within 3 business days after acceptance and credited to the price at closing.
Closing takes place on or before {{closing}}. The Seller delivers possession at closing, with clear title, free of liens other than those the Buyer accepts.
This offer is subject only to the contingencies the Buyer checks below.

[[check?:Buyer:Financing contingency]] **Financing.** The Buyer must obtain a loan commitment within 21 days after acceptance. If the Buyer cannot obtain it after a good-faith effort, the Buyer may cancel this offer and the earnest money is returned.

[[check?:Buyer:Inspection contingency]] **Inspection.** The Buyer may have the Property inspected within 10 days after acceptance. If the inspection is not satisfactory to the Buyer, the Buyer may ask for repairs or a credit, or cancel this offer and receive the earnest money back.

[[check?:Buyer:Appraisal contingency]] **Appraisal.** The Property must appraise at no less than the purchase price. If it appraises lower, the parties may agree a new price; otherwise the Buyer may cancel this offer and receive the earnest money back.

[[check?:Buyer:Home sale contingency]] **Sale of the Buyer's home.** The Buyer's current home must sell and close before the closing date. If it has not, either party may cancel this offer and the earnest money is returned.
This offer expires at 5:00 p.m. local time on {{expires}} unless the Seller accepts it by signing below before then.

then.p: The Buyer signs this offer first. The Seller accepts it by signing after the Buyer. A counteroffer is a new offer and is not an acceptance.
Both buyers sign this offer first. The Seller accepts it by signing after both buyers. A counteroffer is a new offer and is not an acceptance.
